findings.description: The joiner conditional is inverted when moved into get_help_spec. The original was `"; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`, but the new code uses `"; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / "`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an option with both primary and secondary opts, such as `--shout/--no-shout`. The help left column now renders as `--shout; --no-shout` instead of `--shout / --no-shout`. With slash-prefixed opts, such as `/debug`, it renders ` / ` instead of `; `. This changes the help output of every boolean flag option.
